name: centry-adviser-coordination
description:
Compare supplied adviser statements by fact, assumption and recommendation, retain document references, identify differences for clarification, and edit an issue and responsibility tracker. Does not determine which professional opinion is correct.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Differences are questions for clarification, not a verdict on which legal or tax opinion is correct. Proposed owners are not appointed. Requires human verification of source accuracy and topic alignment. No adviser messaging or calendar integration.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

defaultPrompt: My accountant and financial adviser disagree. Help me compare their advice.
Organise who needs to do what across my advisers.

positive.prompt: Open Centry Adviser Coordination so I can organise conflicting accountant and adviser statements.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Centry Adviser Coordination workspace. Return productId adviser-coordination, kind open, required input questions and scope limitations. Do not insert fictional customer facts or require a booking.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry Adviser Coordination: Compare supplied adviser statements by fact, assumption and recommendation, retain document references, identify differences for clarification, and edit an issue and responsibility tracker. Does not determine which professional opinion is correct. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports. Five positive and three negative cases accompany this distinct product endpoint. No account or payment is required for the planning utility.
